name: com.ticketmaster.presencesdk.eventlist.TmxTicketsPrefetcher$TicketsCacheService
description: After Ticketmaster Presence SDK fetches ticket data ahead of opening a ticket, this background service processes the response, updates cached ticket, transfer, and resale information, and tells the app that the ticket list changed.
disableEffect: The ticket list will not receive the ticket updates processed by this background refresh.
